يمتعضن (form VIII)
# يَمْتَعِضْنَ (yamtaʕiḍna) /jam.ta.ʕidˤ.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَعَضَ (imtaʕaḍa)
# يُمْتَعَضْنَ (yumtaʕaḍna) /jum.ta.ʕadˤ.na/: third-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَعَضَ (imtaʕaḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
